// Run in a disposable copy of Interceptor's cmd/interceptor package. Captures
// native exporter output; no Docker, running target, or Operator serializers.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/intrusiveai/interceptor_sandbox/internal/adaptive"
	"github.com/intrusiveai/interceptor_sandbox/internal/blobstore"
	"github.com/intrusiveai/interceptor_sandbox/internal/digest"
	"github.com/intrusiveai/interceptor_sandbox/internal/environment"
	"github.com/intrusiveai/interceptor_sandbox/internal/evaluation"
	"github.com/intrusiveai/interceptor_sandbox/internal/recording"
	"github.com/intrusiveai/interceptor_sandbox/internal/session"
	"github.com/intrusiveai/interceptor_sandbox/internal/snapshot"
	"github.com/intrusiveai/interceptor_sandbox/internal/statejournal"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestOperatorEvidenceFixture(t *testing.T) {
	root := t.TempDir()
	dest := os.Getenv("OPERATOR_EVIDENCE_FIXTURE_DIR")
	if dest == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing destination")
	}
	env := filepath.Join(root, "environment")
	must := func(err error) {
		t.Helper()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	must(os.CopyFS(env, os.DirFS("../../examples/delivery-contract-environment")))
	lock, _, err := environment.Seal(env, time.Unix(0, 0))
	must(err)
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	capabilityRaw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dest, "capability-delivery.json"))
	must(err)
	var capability struct {
		Digest string `json:"digest"`
	}
	must(json.Unmarshal(capabilityRaw, &capability))
	m := session.Metadata{SchemaVersion: 1, ID: "sess-1-000000000000000000000000", CampaignID: "campaign-1", OperationAPIVersion: adaptive.OperationRequestVersion, Phase: session.Stopped, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now, EnvironmentPath: env, EnvironmentDigest: lock.EnvironmentDigest, AppDigest: lock.ApplicationDigest, CapabilityManifestDigest: capability.Digest, FeedbackProfile: "black-box", Limits: session.Limits{MaxBlobBytes: 2 << 20}, Taints: []string{}}
	p, events, journal, err := session.Initialize(root, m, "")
	must(err)
	must(snapshot.WriteManifest(p.FileManifest, snapshot.EmptyManifest()))
	store, err := blobstore.Open(p.Blobs, 2<<20)
	must(err)
	artifacts, err := adaptive.OpenArtifactRegistry(filepath.Join(p.Root, "artifacts.json"), store, 2<<20)
	must(err)
	content := []byte("retained native feedback <&>\n")
	descriptor := adaptive.ArtifactDescriptor{Digest: digest.Bytes(content), SizeBytes: int64(len(content)), MediaType: "text/plain", Canonicalization: "raw"}
	_, err = artifacts.Register(t.Context(), descriptor, bytes.NewReader(content))
	must(err)
	attempts, err := adaptive.OpenAttemptRegistry(filepath.Join(p.Root, "attempts.json"), "black-box", 100, artifacts)
	must(err)
	attempt, err := attempts.Register(adaptive.AttemptContext{APIVersion: adaptive.AttemptContextVersion, CampaignID: m.CampaignID, ThreadID: "thread-1", AttemptID: "attempt-1", Generation: 1, AttemptIndex: 1, Payload: descriptor, Generator: adaptive.Generator{Kind: "attack_harness"}, FeedbackProfile: "black-box", CreatedAt: now})
	must(err)
	_, err = events.Append(recording.Draft{Channel: recording.Attack, Layer: "application", Kind: "turn_completed", Provenance: recording.Application, AttemptID: attempt.AttemptID, Semantic: map[string]any{"output_ref": descriptor.Digest}})
	must(err)
	must(events.Close())
	value, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"source": "fixture"})
	_, err = journal.Append("fixture", []statejournal.Operation{{Kind: "oracle_state_set", Value: value}})
	must(err)
	txs, err := statejournal.VerifyFile(p.Journal)
	must(err)
	cp, err := snapshot.NewCheckpoint(m.ID, "", m.EnvironmentDigest, m.AppDigest, txs[len(txs)-1].Seq, txs[len(txs)-1].Hash, snapshot.EmptyManifest().Digest, 0, 2, "baseline", "fixture", now, snapshot.Metadata{CampaignID: m.CampaignID, Description: "Captured native lineage"})
	must(err)
	write := func(name string, v any) { raw, err := json.Marshal(v); must(err); must(os.WriteFile(name, raw, 0600)) }
	write(filepath.Join(p.Checkpoints, cp.ID+".json"), cp)
	req := adaptive.OperationRequest{APIVersion: adaptive.OperationRequestVersion, RequestID: "operation-1", OperationID: "operation-1", Operation: "session.owner", SessionID: m.ID, CampaignID: m.CampaignID, WorkerInstanceID: "worker-1", RunRevision: 1, BodyDigest: digest.Bytes([]byte(`{}`)), Deadline: now.Add(time.Minute)}
	state := adaptive.ExecutionState{APIVersion: adaptive.ExecutionStateVersion, SessionID: m.ID, ClosedAt: &now, ClosureReason: "controller_closed_execution", Owner: &adaptive.ExecutionOwner{Principal: "operator", CampaignID: m.CampaignID, WorkerInstanceID: "worker-1", RunRevision: 1, BoundAt: now, ClosedAt: &now}, Records: map[string]*adaptive.OperationRecord{"operation-1": {Request: req, Fingerprint: adaptive.OperationFingerprint(req), State: "completed", Response: adaptive.GatewayResponse{Status: 200, SessionRevision: 1, Body: json.RawMessage(`{}`)}, AdmittedAt: now, FinishedAt: &now}}}
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(state)
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(p.Root, "execution.json"), raw, 0600))
	value, _ = json.Marshal(map[string]string{"execution_state_digest": digest.Bytes(raw), "session_id": m.ID})
	_, err = journal.Append("execution_state", []statejournal.Operation{{Kind: "idempotency_commit", Value: value}})
	must(err)
	must(journal.Close())
	report := evaluation.Report{Oracles: []evaluation.OracleResult{}, Injections: []evaluation.InjectionResult{}, Coverage: []string{}}
	write(filepath.Join(p.Root, "final-evaluation.json"), report)
	m, _, err = session.Load(root, m.ID)
	must(err)
	must(exportEvidence(t.Context(), root, m, p, filepath.Join(dest, "native-evidence.tar"), 4<<20))
	must(os.Remove(filepath.Join(p.Root, "final-evaluation.json")))
	must(exportEvidence(t.Context(), root, m, p, filepath.Join(dest, "native-evidence-partial.tar"), 4<<20))
	child := m
	child.ID = "sess-2-000000000000000000000000"
	child.ParentSessionID = m.ID
	child.ParentCheckpoint = cp.ID
	p2, e2, j2, err := session.Initialize(root, child, "")
	must(err)
	must(e2.Close())
	must(snapshot.WriteManifest(p2.FileManifest, snapshot.EmptyManifest()))
	must(os.CopyFS(p2.Blobs, os.DirFS(p.Blobs)))
	for _, name := range []string{"artifacts.json", "attempts.json"} {
		data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(p.Root, name))
		must(err)
		must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(p2.Root, name), data, 0600))
	}
	must(os.Mkdir(filepath.Join(p2.Root, "restore-source"), 0700))
	write(filepath.Join(p2.Root, "restore-source/checkpoint.json"), cp)
	var source bytes.Buffer
	for _, tx := range txs {
		raw, _ := json.Marshal(tx)
		source.Write(raw)
		source.WriteByte('\n')
	}
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(p2.Root, "restore-source/state.jsonl"), source.Bytes(), 0600))
	state.SessionID = child.ID
	state.Records = map[string]*adaptive.OperationRecord{}
	state.Owner.RunRevision = 2
	raw, _ = json.Marshal(state)
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(p2.Root, "execution.json"), raw, 0600))
	value, _ = json.Marshal(map[string]string{"execution_state_digest": digest.Bytes(raw), "session_id": child.ID})
	_, err = j2.Append("execution_state", []statejournal.Operation{{Kind: "idempotency_commit", Value: value}})
	must(err)
	must(j2.Close())
	write(filepath.Join(p2.Root, "final-evaluation.json"), report)
	child, _, err = session.Load(root, child.ID)
	must(err)
	must(exportEvidence(t.Context(), root, child, p2, filepath.Join(dest, "native-evidence-restored.tar"), 4<<20))

}
